claim_wording.becomes_available: The Right's stated condition, training apprentices from outside the lineage (E7), becomes something that can be shown rather than only stated.
claim_wording.changes: Without that demonstration the Right is exposed, as E3 states. E3 is agent-proposed.
claim_wording.development: Outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right and their repair is demonstrated, so the condition the Right carries is tested (proposed).

result.reasoning: Only E7 and E3 carry the condition, and both are attributed agent_proposed; E3 says its stake in the review is an agent inference. E1 establishes that from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right, but not the training condition. The claim is labelled proposed, so as a proposal it is not an error, but its premise is not record. The exposure premise rests on E3 alone.
result.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
result.alternative_reading: The offered quote carries the condition but not its status: E7 is written as fact, yet its attribution is agent_proposed. Not stated in the cited items: any author statement of the condition, or what the source's reversal of the review point (E7) changes.
result.would_settle: An author-stated or established item that states the condition; until then it stays a proposal.
result.creative_room: Still open: the condition can be tested in a later Book, with outside apprentices trained and their repair shown, or the Right can stay untested and exposed as E3 proposes. Treat as proposals, not record: the condition itself, the exposure premise, and the demonstration step.
